build_evaluator: build a chess metrics evaluator from a predictor and eval config for action value, state value, or behavioral cloning policies
create_ChessStaticMetrics: create a ChessStaticMetrics dataclass instance with fen, action accuracy, log loss, kendall tau, entropy, and optional loss fields
test_ActionValueChessStaticMetricsEvalua: test the ActionValueChessStaticMetricsEvaluator by calling step with haiku params to compute action-value metrics over a dataset
test_StateValueChessStaticMetricsEvaluat: test the StateValueChessStaticMetricsEvaluator by calling step with haiku params to compute state-value and consistency metrics
test_BCChessStaticMetricsEvaluator: test the BCChessStaticMetricsEvaluator by calling step with haiku params to compute behavioral cloning action metrics
